test_case_results.user_message:
Use the commit-message skill to write the commit message for the staged changes. Do not run git commit, and do not change any file. Reply with the commit message only.

This change fixes issue #12: the done command crashed with a TypeError when the index did not exist.
test_case_results.final_text:
Fix crash in `completeTask` when index does not exist

Guard against an out-of-range index by throwing a clear error instead of
letting `task.isDone = true` throw a TypeError on `undefined`.

Fixes #12

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
